## Description

Cluster assets by correlation and allocate recursively to reduce concentration without relying on a standard mean-variance optimizer.

## Where it may fit

Diversified universes with unstable covariance estimates or strong cluster structure.

## Vehicles

Multi-asset funds, ETF allocations, risk-controlled portfolios.

## Required data

Synchronized returns, correlation/covariance matrix, asset universe and constraints.

## Caveats

Clustering is sensitive to window and distance metric; HRP does not guarantee lower realized risk.
